question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Succesful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word **"Succesful"** is actually spelled **"Successful"**, which means accomplishing an aim or purpose. (सफल)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of hard work, she became a successful entrepreneur.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

Therefore, the erroneous spelling is: **Succesful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Relevant **(प्रासंगिक): Closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered.

 
 
• **Example:** She asked me a lot of questions relevant to my job.
 
 
 
• **Queue **(कतार): A line or sequence of people or vehicles awaiting their turn to be attended to or to proceed.
 
 
• **Example: **We waited in the queue for hours to get the concert tickets.
 
 
 
• The word "Rhyme" refers to a correspondence of sound between words or the endings of words, especially when these are used at the ends of lines of poetry. (तुक)
 
 
• Example: The poet skillfully used rhyme to give a musical quality to her verses.
